name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:

theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intros Hnorm
  induction post <;>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, extractOldExprVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
  case app fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    . simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
      intros x Hin
      exact Hin
    . next Hfalse =>
      cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      exfalso
      specialize Hn ?_
      constructor
      cases Hn
      apply Hfalse
      rfl
    . cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      apply List.Subset.app
      . apply List.Subset.trans
        apply fn_ih
        exact H1
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
      . apply List.Subset.trans
        apply e_ih
        exact H2
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
  case abs ih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply ih <;> assumption
  case quant trih eih =>
    cases Hnorm
    rename_i e_normalized
    rename_i tr_normalized
    rename_i tr e ty k
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply trih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply eih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply cih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply tih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply eih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih1 <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih2 <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  induction Hup
  · exact ⟨_, InitStatesUpdated Hinit, Hinit, .update_none⟩
  next σ x v σ₀ xs vs σ₁ Hup Hups ih =>
    obtain ⟨Hxval⟩ := id Hup
    obtain ⟨_, rfl, -, Hup₂⟩ := ih Hinit
    have H1 := updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength Hinit)
      (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) $ .update_some Hup Hups)
      (InitStatesNodup Hinit)
    refine ⟨_, rfl, H1, .update_some ?_ Hup₂⟩
    simp only [UpdateStateUpdated Hup, updatedStates, ← updatedStateComm' $ by
      rw [List.unzip_zip $ InitStatesLength Hinit]
      intro Hin
      cases Hxval.symm.trans $ InitStatesNotDefined H1 x Hin]
    exact updatedStateUpdate $ InitStatesSomeMonotone Hxval H1

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
    rw [funext_iff]
    by_contra h₀
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx0⟩ := not_forall.1 h₀
    have hinner : Continuous (λx => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
      Continuous.inner' f (λ_ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
    have hself : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (real_inner_self_nonneg') λh => hx0 $ inner_self_eq_zero'.mp h.symm
    obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδ⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
      ((hinner.continuousAt).preimage_mem_nhds $ Ioi_mem_nhds hself)
    have inner_pos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ, 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := λx hx => hδ hx
    have bump_exists : ∃ φ : Y → ℝ, IsTestFunction φ ∧ φ x₀ > 0 ∧
        (∀ x ∈ Function.support φ, 0 ≤ φ x) ∧
        Function.support φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ (δ/2) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ $ δ/4, 0 < φ x) := by
          haveI : HasContDiffBump Y := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
          let φ1 : ContDiffBump x₀ :=
            ⟨δ / 4, δ / 2, by positivity, by linarith⟩
          refine ⟨φ1.toFun, ⟨φ1.contDiff, φ1.hasCompactSupport⟩,
            φ1.pos_of_mem_ball $ Metric.mem_ball_self φ1.rOut_pos, λx _ => φ1.nonneg,
            by rw [ContDiffBump.support_eq], λx hx => φ1.pos_of_mem_ball ?_⟩
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hx
          exact Metric.mem_ball.mpr $ lt_of_le_of_lt hx $ by show δ / 4 < δ / 2; linarith
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ_testfun, hφ_pos_x₀, hφ_non_neg, hφ_support_subset, hφ_pos_inner⟩ :=
      bump_exists
    let g : Y → V := λx => φ x • f x₀
    have hg_test : IsTestFunction g := IsTestFunction.smul_right hφ_testfun contDiff_const
    have key_integral := hg g hg_test
    simp only [g, inner_smul_right'] at key_integral
    have support_subset : Function.support φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ δ :=
      hφ_support_subset.trans $ Metric.ball_subset_ball $ by linarith
    have supp_subset2 : Function.support (λx => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) ⊆ Function.support φ := by
      intro x hprod hφ0
      simp [hφ0] at hprod
    have integrable_prod :
      Integrable (λx => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) μ :=
      (Continuous.mul hφ_testfun.smooth.continuous hinner).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hφ_testfun.supp.mono supp_subset2)
    have h_nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Function.support φ
      · exact mul_nonneg (hφ_non_neg x hx) (inner_pos x $ support_subset hx).le
      · simp [Function.notMem_support.mp hx]
    have hμ : 0 < μ (Metric.closedBall x₀ $ δ/4) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_pos μ $ Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr $ by linarith)
        (measure_mono Metric.ball_subset_closedBall)
    have closedBall_subset_support :
        Metric.closedBall x₀ (δ/4)
          ⊆ Function.support (λx => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := λx hx =>
        mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt $ hφ_pos_inner x hx) $ ne_of_gt $ inner_pos x
          (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hx)
    have integral_pos : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ :=
      (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg h_nonneg integrable_prod).mpr
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hμ $ measure_mono closedBall_subset_support)
    linarith

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (λy => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    λj => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le $ right_eq_inf.mp rfl) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] λy => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    λj k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (λs => ∂[j] (λy => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    λj => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le $ right_eq_inf.mp rfl) (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (λs => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable $ by simp) x i
  calc _
    _= ∂ₜ (λt =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, Space.deriv j (λx => magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c A t x (j, i)) x -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity 𝓕.c J t x i) t := by
        conv_lhs =>
          enter [1]
          change λt => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) t
          enter [t]
          rw [Time.deriv_euclid $ electricField_differentiable_time
            (hA.of_le $ right_eq_inf.mp rfl) _,
            time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∂ₜ (λt => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x) t -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub]
      simp only [one_div, mul_inv_rev, FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply]
      rw [fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum λj _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
        fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]
      simp [Time.deriv_eq]
      · exact ((Differentiable.fun_sum λj _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
      · exact hJt.differentiableAt.const_mul _
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ((∑ j, ∂ₜ λt => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x) t) -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * (∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t) := by
      congr
      rw [Time.deriv_eq]
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum λi _ => (hBt i).differentiableAt]
      simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
      rfl
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∑ j, ∂[j] λx => ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · x (j, i)) t) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      congr
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
      congr
      funext k
      rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv]
      apply magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff
      apply hA.of_le $ right_eq_inf.mp rfl
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) *(∑ j, ∂[j] λx => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x -
        ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext k
        congr
        funext x
        rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ $ hA.of_le $ ENat.LEInfty.out]
    _ = (1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (λx => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x -
          ∂[j] (λx => ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x)) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext j
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hEd _ _).differentiableAt (hEd _ _).differentiableAt]
        simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (λx => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (λx => ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by simp [mul_sub]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (λx => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
        1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[i] (λx => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        funext j
        rw [Space.deriv_commute _ $ hEs _, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (λx => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∂[i] (λx => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        rw [fderiv_fun_sum]
        simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        intro j _
        exact (hEd j j).differentiableAt
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (λx => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∂[i] (λx => (∇ ⬝ (A.electricField 𝓕.c t)) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        rfl
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀ ^ 2) * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr 2
        rw [isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix] at h

        conv_lhs =>
          enter [2, 2, x]
          rw [(h t x).1]
        trans 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * Space.deriv i
            (λx => (1/ 𝓕.ε₀) * LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity 𝓕.c J t x) x
        · congr
          funext x
          ring
        · rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
          rw [fderiv_const_mul]
          simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
          field_simp
          apply Differentiable.differentiableAt
          apply LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
          exact hJ.differentiable $ by simp
        · exact hA
        · exact hJ
      _ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
            𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
            𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
          simp [FreeSpace.c_sq]
          field_simp

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
    Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))
  change pb b $ Basis.mem_span _ b
  apply Submodule.span_induction
  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pb]
    let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
      Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a* ofCrAnListF φs))
    change pa a $ Basis.mem_span _ a
    apply Submodule.span_induction
    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pa]
      have hmid : ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) • ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) =
          ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF := by
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
        simp [← ofCrAnListF_append]
      let l := (List.takeWhile (λc => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel $ φs' ++ φs))
      let l' := (List.filter (λc =>
        (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')
      let r := (List.filter (λc => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
        (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel $ φs' ++ φs))
      let r' := (List.filter (λc => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)
      have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
        (by simp_all)
      have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
        (by simp_all)
      have h3 : List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs) = l ++ (l' ++ (r' ++ r)) := by
        rw [insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs]
        simp only [l, l', r, r', List.append_assoc]
      have e1 : φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs := by simp
      have e2 : φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs := by simp
      calc ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs)
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF $ crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs)) -
            crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) •
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF $ crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
          module
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF l) * ι (ofCrAnListF l') * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
            ι (ofCrAnListF r') * ι (ofCrAnListF r)) := by
          rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, crAnTimeOrderList, e1, h1,
            crAnTimeOrderList, e2, h2]
          simp only [map_mul, mul_assoc, ofCrAnListF_append, l, l', r, r', hmid.symm,
            mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_sub, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
        _ = ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs) := by
          rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp $ ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ]
          repeat rw [mul_assoc]
          rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
            ← ofCrAnListF_append]
          rw [← h3, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
          by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
          · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
          · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ
              (by push_neg at hq; exact hq.symm),
              ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    · simp only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, pa]
    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
      simp_all [pa,mul_add, add_mul]
    · intro x hx hpx

  · simp only [map_mul, mul_zero, map_zero, pb]
  · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l with val_l | red_l
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with val_r | red_r
      · obtain ⟨σ, t₁, eq⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
        subst eq
        exact ⟨_, Red.abs val_l.lc val_r⟩
      · exact ⟨_, Red.appᵣ val_l red_r.choose_spec⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.appₗ r.wf.2.1 red_l.choose_spec⟩
  case tapp der sub ih =>
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with val | red
    · obtain ⟨δ, t, eq⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
      subst eq
      exact ⟨_, Red.tabs val.lc sub.wf.2.1.lc⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.tapp sub.wf.2.1.lc red.choose_spec⟩
  case let' der _ ih _ =>
    right
    have hb := (Term.body_let.mp der'.wf.2.1).2
    rcases ih rfl der with val | red
    · exact ⟨_, Red.let_body val hb⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.let_bind red.choose_spec hb⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    exact (ih rfl der).imp Value.inl λr => ⟨.inl r.choose, Red.inl r.choose_spec⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    exact (ih rfl der).imp Value.inr λr => ⟨.inr r.choose, Red.inr r.choose_spec⟩
  case case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    have hb := Term.body_case.mp der'.wf.2.1
    rcases ih rfl der with val | red
    · obtain ⟨u, eq | eq⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val <;> subst eq
      · cases val with
        | inl v => exact ⟨_, Red.case_inl v hb.2.1 hb.2.2⟩
      · cases val with
        | inr v => exact ⟨_, Red.case_inr v hb.2.1 hb.2.2⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.case red.choose_spec hb.2.1 hb.2.2⟩
  case abs L _ _ =>
    left
    constructor
    grind only [LC.abs L, → wf, cases Term.LC]
  case tabs L _ _ =>
    left
    constructor
    grind only [LC.tabs L, → wf, cases Term.LC]
  all_goals grind

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  · exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I ..⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    · rename_i hc ha
      cases hc
      exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I ..⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K ..⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    · rename_i ha hc
      obtain ⟨a₁', h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, h, .red_K ..⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    · rename_i hd hc
      obtain ⟨a', b', h1, h2, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hd
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par h1 hc) $ .par h2 hc, .red_S ..⟩
  · rename_i ha' hb' iha ihb
    cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha' hb'⟩
    · cases ha'
      exact ⟨_, .red_I .., hb'⟩
    · obtain ⟨a₂', h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha'
      exact ⟨_, .red_K .., h⟩
    · obtain ⟨a'', c', h1, h2, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha'
      exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par h1 hb') $ .par h2 hb'⟩
    · rename_i ha'' hb''
      obtain ⟨a₃, ha⟩ := iha ha''
      obtain ⟨b₃, hb⟩ := ihb hb''
      exact ⟨_, .par ha.1 hb.1, .par ha.2 hb.2⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro hpq
  refine ⟨ChoiceBisim, .choice hpq, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  rcases hr with ⟨h⟩ | ⟨h⟩
  · constructor <;> intro s htr <;>

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  -- 2 * Δ₀(f, ↑(BBF_Code 𝔽q β ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩)) < ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩)
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C_i := (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_H := Code.distFromCode f C_i
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 $ ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d_i_plus_steps := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩
  have h_d_i_gt_0 : d_i > 0 := Nat.succ_pos _
  -- 1. Relate Hamming distance `d_H` to fiber-wise distance `d_fw`.
  obtain ⟨g', h_g'_mem, h_g'_min_card⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw
    = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    -- Let `S` be the set of all possible fiber-wise disagreement sizes.
    let S := (fun (g : C_i) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
      f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
    obtain ⟨g_subtype, _, h_eq⟩ := (Set.mem_image _ _ _).mp
      (Nat.sInf_mem ⟨_, Set.mem_image_of_mem _ $ Set.mem_univ (0 : C_i)⟩)
    exact ⟨g_subtype.val, g_subtype.property, h_eq.symm⟩
  -- The Hamming distance to any codeword `g'` is bounded by `d_fw * 2 ^ steps`.
  have h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    change (Δ₀(f, g') : ℕ∞) ≤ ↑d_fw * ((2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
    rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_le_coe, h_g'_min_card]
    -- Let ΔH be the finset of actually bad x points where f and g' disagree.
    let ΔH := Finset.filter (λx => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    -- Y_bad is the set of quotient points y that THERE EXISTS a bad fiber point x
    let Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    have hFinType_Y_bad : Fintype Y_bad := Fintype.ofFinite ↑Y_bad
    -- Every point of disagreement `x` must belong to a fiber over some `y` in `Y_bad`.
    have h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points : ΔH ⊆ Y_bad.toFinset.biUnion
        (λy => ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
          (Finset.univ : Finset $ Fin $ 2 ^ steps)).toFinset) := by
      intro x hx_in_ΔH
      simp only [ΔH, Finset.mem_filter] at hx_in_ΔH
      let y_of_x := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      have h_elemenet_Y_bad : y_of_x ∈ Y_bad.toFinset :=
        Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, hx_in_ΔH.2⟩
      refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨y_of_x, h_elemenet_Y_bad, ?_⟩
      simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and]
      use (pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (x := x))
      exact is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega)
        (x := x) (y := y_of_x).mp $ by rfl
    apply (Finset.card_le_card h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points).trans
    rw [Finset.card_biUnion]
    · simp only [Set.toFinset_card]
      have h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point := card_qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β
        (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i steps h_i_add_steps
      simp only [Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset,
        Subtype.forall] at h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point
      have h_card_fiber_of_each_y : ∀ _y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset,
          Fintype.card ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨↑i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
            (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := _y)) ''
            ↑(Finset.univ : Finset $ Fin $ 2 ^ steps)) = 2 ^ steps := by
        intro y _
        have hy_card_fiber_of_y := h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point (a := y)
          (b := Submodule.coe_mem y)
        simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset, hy_card_fiber_of_y]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_card_fiber_of_each_y]
      simp only [sum_const, Set.toFinset_card, smul_eq_mul, ge_iff_le]
      conv_rhs => rw [←_root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq] -- convert .ncard back to .card
      simp only [card_eq_fintype_card, Y_bad, le_refl]
    · intro y₁ _ y₂ _ hy_ne
      have h_disjoint := qMap_total_fiber_disjoint (i := ⟨↑i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (y₁ := y₁) (y₂ := y₂) (hy_ne := hy_ne)
      simp only [Function.onFun, coe_univ]
      exact h_disjoint
  -- The minimum distance `d_H` is bounded by the distance to this specific `g'`.
  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    refine le_trans (sInf_le ⟨g', h_g'_mem, le_refl _⟩) h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size
  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_i_plus_steps - 1 :=
    Nat.le_of_lt_succ $ WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt
  -- `(d_{i+steps} - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1`.
  have h_algebraic_identity : (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp [d_i, d_i_plus_steps, BBF_CodeDistance]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add];
    have h1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i := by
      rw [← Nat.sub_sub, Nat.sub_add_cancel
        (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' $ h_i_add_steps.trans $ Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡)]
    have h2 : (ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps) = ℓ - i := by
      rw [← Nat.sub_sub, Nat.sub_add_cancel $ Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps]
    rw [h1, h2]
  -- `d_H` is finite since it is bounded by `d_fw * 2 ^ steps`.
  have h_dH_ne_top : d_H ≠ ⊤ := ne_of_lt $ lt_of_le_of_lt h_dist_bridge $ ENat.coe_lt_top _
  let d_H_nat := ENat.toNat d_H
  have h_dH_eq : d_H = d_H_nat := (ENat.coe_toNat h_dH_ne_top).symm
  have h_final_inequality : 2 * d_H_nat ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    have h_bridge_nat : d_H_nat ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
        rw [←ENat.coe_le_coe]
        exact le_of_eq_of_le h_dH_eq.symm h_dist_bridge
    calc 2 * d_H_nat
      _ ≤ 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 h_bridge_nat
      _ = (2 * d_fw) * 2 ^ steps := (Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h_fw_bound
      _ = d_i - 1 := h_algebraic_identity
  change (2 : ℕ∞) * d_H < d_i
  rw [h_dH_eq]
  exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_of_le_pred h_d_i_gt_0 h_final_inequality

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (y := y)
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  have h_eval_qMap (k : Fin 2) :
      (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) $ fiberMap k
    simp only [Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    have h_res := is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)
      (x := fiberMap k) (y := y).mpr
        (by rw [pointToIterateQuotientIndex_qMap_total_fiber_eq_self])
    rw [h.symm, h_res]
  have h_fiber_diff : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    rw [show x₀ = _ from qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0,
      show x₁ = _ from qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, Submodule.coe_add,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_smul, zero_add, add_sub_cancel_right]
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_P_i_eval := evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs
  have h_equation_39 (k : Fin 2) :
      P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [h_P_i_eval, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
      h_eval_qMap k, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
    = P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := rfl
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by
      rw [h_equation_39 0, h_equation_39 1]
      linear_combination (P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal) * h_fiber_diff
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
        Polynomial.eval_C, Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl λj _ => ?_
      ring

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
    classical
    intro ϑ
    induction ϑ with
    | zero =>
      intro u
      contradiction
    | succ ϑ_sub_1 ih =>
      cases ϑ_sub_1 with
      | zero =>
        -- `ϑ = 1`
        simp only [zero_add, gt_iff_lt, zero_lt_one, ModuleCode, forall_const]
        intro u
        let toAffineLineEval := multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (u := u)
        intro hprob_gt
        simp_rw [toAffineLineEval] at hprob_gt
        let prob_eq := prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
          (P := λr => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e)
        -- Convert sampling (r ← (Fin 1 → F)) into sampling (r ← F)
        simp_rw [prob_eq, Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hprob_gt
        have h_correlated_agreement := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hprob_gt
        simp only [jointProximityNat₂, Fin.isValue] at h_correlated_agreement
        have h_u_eq: u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
          funext rowIdx
          match rowIdx with
          | 0 => rfl
          | 1 => rfl
        rw [h_u_eq.symm] at h_correlated_agreement
        exact h_correlated_agreement
      | succ ϑ_sub_2 =>
        intro hϑ_gt_0 u hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        -- `ϑ ≥ 2`
        let n := ϑ_sub_2 + 1
        set U₀ : Fin (2 ^ n) → Word A ι :=
          (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := n) u).1
        set U₁ : Fin (2 ^ n) → Word A ι :=
          (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := n) u).2
        let W₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin $ 2 ^ n) ι from U₀)
        let W₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin $ 2 ^ n) ι from U₁)
        have h_finsnoc_eq_r: ∀ r: Fin (n + 1) → F,
          Fin.snoc (fun (i : Fin n) ↦ r i.castSucc) (r $ Fin.last n) = r :=
          λr => Fin.snoc_init_self r
        let P : F → (Fin n → F) → Prop := λr_last r_init =>
          Δ₀(multilinearCombine (u:=u) (r:=Fin.snoc r_init r_last), MC) ≤ e
        let hP_split_r_last := prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
          (ϑ := n) (F := F) (P := P)
        unfold P at hP_split_r_last
        simp_rw [h_finsnoc_eq_r] at hP_split_r_last
        rw [hP_split_r_last] at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        have multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine
          (r_init : Fin n → F) (r_last : F) : multilinearCombine u (Fin.snoc r_init r_last) =
            multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init := by
          rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form]
          simp only [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.init_snoc]
          rfl
        -- Rewrite the probability using this identity
        simp_rw [multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine]
          at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        let R_star_set := R_star_tensor MC (m:=n) (e:=e) (ε:=ε) U₀ U₁
        -- Show Pr[R*] > ε / q
        have h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q : Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[ r ∈ R_star_set ]
          > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
          let res := prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) (ϑ := n) (u := u)
            (e := e) $ hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
          exact res
        -- Apply Inductive Hypothesis for r_last ∈ R*
        have h_line_close_to_C_m : ∀ (r : R_star_set),
          jointProximityNat (u := affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r.val) (e := e) (C := MC) := by
          intro r_in_Rstar
          apply correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor
            (ih := λu_prev => ih (by omega) u_prev ) (u := u)
        have h_C_m_gap := h_interleaved_gaps (2^n) $ Nat.one_le_two_pow
        -- Pr[line close to C^n] > ε/q, since R* implies it
        have h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q :
          Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[
            Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u₀ := W₀) (u₁ := W₁) (r := r),
              ((MC ^⋈ (Fin $ 2 ^ n)))) ≤ e
          ] > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
            apply lt_of_le_of_lt' _ h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q
            exact Pr_le_Pr_of_implies (D := $ᵖ F) (f := λr => r ∈ R_star_set)
              (g := λr => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u₀ := W₀) (u₁ := W₁) (r := r),
                ((MC ^⋈ (Fin $ 2 ^ n)))) ≤ e)
              (λr hr_in_Rstar => h_line_close_to_C_m ⟨r, hr_in_Rstar⟩)
        apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
        exact h_C_m_gap W₀ W₁ h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  have h_main : ∃ i j : ℕ, i < j ∧ ∀ t < 4, u (i + t) = u (j + t) := by
    have s := Set.finite_Icc B T
    have hfin : (Set.range λn => (⟨u n, u $ n + 1, u $ n + 2, u $ n + 3⟩ : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)).Finite :=
      (s.prod $ s.prod $ s.prod s).subset
        (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr λn => ⟨hB n, hB $ n + 1, hB $ n + 2, hB $ n + 3⟩)
    obtain ⟨i, j, heq, hne⟩ := Function.not_injective_iff.mp
      λhinj => hfin.not_infinite $ Set.infinite_range_of_injective hinj
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
    have heq4 : ∀ t < 4, u (i + t) = u (j + t) := by
      intro t ht
      rcases (show t = 0 ∨ t = 1 ∨ t = 2 ∨ t = 3 from by omega) with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · simp only [Nat.add_zero]
        exact heq.1
      · exact heq.2.1
      · exact heq.2.2.1
      · exact heq.2.2.2
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hij | hij
    · exact ⟨i, j, hij, heq4⟩
    · exact ⟨j, i, hij, λt ht => (heq4 t ht).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq4⟩ := h_main
  have hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, u (n + 4) = ((u (n + 3) + u (n + 2) + u (n + 1) * u (n + 0)) : ℝ) /
      ((u (n + 3) * u (n + 2) + u (n + 1) + u (n + 0)) : ℝ) := by
    intro n
    have h := (hu (n + 4) $ by omega).1
    rw [show (n + 4) - 1 = n + 3 from by omega, show (n + 4) - 2 = n + 2 from by omega,
      show (n + 4) - 3 = n + 1 from by omega, show (n + 4) - 4 = n + 0 from by omega] at h
    exact h
  have hstep : ∀ a b : ℕ, (∀ t < 4, u (a + t) = u (b + t)) → u (a + 4) = u (b + 4) := by
    intro a b h
    exact Int.cast_injective
      (by rw [hrec a, hrec b, h 0 $ by omega, h 1 $ by omega, h 2 $ by omega, h 3 $ by omega])
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge m 4 with hm | hm
      · exact heq4 m hm
      · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 4 := ⟨m - 4, by omega⟩
        simp only [← Nat.add_assoc]
        exact hstep (i + k) (j + k) λt _ =>
          by simpa only [← Nat.add_assoc] using ih (k + t) $ by omega
  refine ⟨i, j - i, by omega, λn hn => ?_⟩
  have h9 := key $ n - i
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hn, show j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) from by omega] at h9
  exact h9.symm

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  have key : ∀ A : Set S, A ∉ P → ∃ U ∈ P, ∀ x ∈ A, x ∉ U := by
    intro A hA
    by_contra! h
    refine hPS ⟨A, hA, λU hU hAU => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hxA, hxU⟩ := h U hU
    exact (hAU ▸ Set.mem_inter hxA hxU : x ∈ (∅ : Set S))
  have dich : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_contra! h
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩ := key A h.1
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hVc⟩ := key Aᶜ h.2
    exact hPP U hU V hV $ Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem λx hx =>
      hVc x (λhxA => hAU x hxA hx.1) hx.2
  classical
  set Q : Finset (Set S) := P.map (⟨compl, compl_injective⟩ : Set S ↪ Set S) with hQdef
  have hQcard : Q.card = P.card := Finset.card_map _
  have hpart : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∪ Q := by
    intro A
    rcases dich A with hA | hA
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left Q hA
    · exact Finset.mem_union_right P $ by
        simp only [hQdef, Finset.mem_map]
        exact ⟨Aᶜ, hA, compl_compl A⟩
  have h2 : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h1 : P ∪ Q = Finset.univ := Finset.eq_univ_of_forall hpart
    have hd : Disjoint P Q := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro A hA hA'
      simp only [hQdef, Finset.mem_map] at hA'
      obtain ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩ := hA'
      exact hPP B hB Bᶜ hA $ inter_compl_self B
    rw [← Finset.card_univ.trans $ Fintype.card_set (α := S), ← h1,
      Finset.card_union_eq_card_add_card.mpr hd]
  have h4 : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h5 : Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S := by
      have := Fintype.card_pos (α := S)
      omega
    conv_rhs => rw [← h5]
    rw [pow_add, pow_one]
  linarith

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  obtain ⟨-, h2⟩ := (hrelation d e).mp h.1
  obtain ⟨-, h4⟩ := (hrelation e f).mp h.2
  -- replacing digit i of x by y i changes the number by (y i - x i) * 10^i
  have key : ∀ (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9),
      digits_to_num (λj => if j = i then y j else x j)
        = digits_to_num x + (y i - x i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro x y i
    have hh : ∀ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then y j else x j) * 10 ^ j.1
        = x j * 10 ^ j.1 + (if j = i then (y j - x j) * 10 ^ j.1 else 0) := by
      intro j
      split_ifs <;> ring
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, hh]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ i _, if_pos $ Finset.mem_univ i]
  have hte : ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 = digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d := by
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hce : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
    have hE : ∑ i : Fin 9, (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1)
        - 7 * digits_to_num d = digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
      simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hte] <;> ring
    exact hE ▸ dvd_sub (Finset.dvd_sum λi _ => key d e i ▸ h2 i) ⟨digits_to_num d, rfl⟩
  have hstep : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro i
    have h5 := dvd_add (key d e i ▸ h2 i) $ key e f i ▸ h4 i
    rw [add_add_add_comm, ← add_mul, sub_add_sub_cancel'] at h5
    have h6 := dvd_sub h5 hce
    rwa [add_sub_cancel_left] at h6
  intro i
  rcases (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr $ by decide).dvd_mul.mp $ hstep i with h | h
  · rw [← dvd_neg, neg_sub]
    exact h
  · norm_cast at h
    exact absurd (Nat.Prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow (by decide) h) $ by decide
